451 receipts carry the title only as a SHA-256 — the day record does not re-publish what the law removed; the pre-committed sample manifest remains the receipt.
403/429 bot-walls and network failures are unverifiable and excluded from the denominator, disclosed as counts.
A 200 that shows different content (soft deletion) counts as ok — the gone rate is a floor.
